name: Ixidor, Reality Sculptor and Break Open — "target face-down creature" lists face-down creatures, and turns the pick face up
notes: 2026-11-19. The target filter read "face-down" as a creature subtype, so every "target face-down creature" picker was empty and Ixidor's "Face-down creatures get +1/+1" reached nobody; it now reads the permanent's face-down state (buildAppliesToFromText, carried in createBaseState, snapshotState and _restrictionState). Ixidor's fired ability is picked on the opponent's face-down Gray Ogre and turns it face up (a 2/2 Ogre again); your face-down Hill Giant stays face down and gets +1/+1 (a 3/3). Break Open ("… an opponent controls") lists only the opponent's face-down creature, and turns nothing once it is removed: Craw Wurm, picked and then the spell taken away, is face down again.
